# Inertia.Net

> Inertia.Net is a .NET 10 and .NET 11 server adapter for Inertia.js v3. ASP.NET Core endpoints (Minimal APIs, MVC or FastEndpoints) return a page component name and props; React, Vue or Svelte renders them. There is no separate JSON API or client-side router.

Full documentation as one file: https://inertia-dotnet.temtem.dev/llms-full.txt. Agent conventions: https://inertia-dotnet.temtem.dev/docs/ai-agents.

## Get started

- [Introduction](https://inertia-dotnet.temtem.dev/docs/introduction): Inertia.Net is a .NET 10 and .NET 11 server adapter for Inertia.js v3. Build React, Vue and Svelte apps without a separate API.
- [Why Inertia?](https://inertia-dotnet.temtem.dev/docs/why-inertia): What Inertia is, how it compares to React, Vue or Svelte with a Web API, and the features and prop types Inertia.Net adds.
- [Installation](https://inertia-dotnet.temtem.dev/docs/installation): Install Inertia.Net, the optional MVC, FastEndpoints or SignalR package, and the testing helpers.
- [First 10 minutes](https://inertia-dotnet.temtem.dev/docs/first-10-minutes): Start a template app, try its validated form, and test the redirect.
- [Client setup](https://inertia-dotnet.temtem.dev/docs/client-setup): Configure Vite and the React, Vue or Svelte client for an Inertia.Net app.
- [Quick start](https://inertia-dotnet.temtem.dev/docs/quick-start): Add Inertia.Net to an ASP.NET Core app, create the root template and render your first page.
- [AI agents](https://inertia-dotnet.temtem.dev/docs/ai-agents): Give coding agents the context and conventions they need to build Inertia.Net pages correctly.

## Essentials

- [Pages and responses](https://inertia-dotnet.temtem.dev/docs/pages-and-responses): Render components, use MapInertia, and understand the root template and response status codes.
- [Props](https://inertia-dotnet.temtem.dev/docs/props): Lazy, optional, deferred, merged, once, cached and rescued page data.
- [Shared data](https://inertia-dotnet.temtem.dev/docs/shared-data): Share props with every page, statically or per request, and control the shared prop key list.
- [Validation](https://inertia-dotnet.temtem.dev/docs/validation-and-errors): Redirect back with validation errors for Minimal APIs, MVC and FastEndpoints, and add Precognition.
- [Flash data](https://inertia-dotnet.temtem.dev/docs/flash-data): Carry a one-time message, toast or typed value across a redirect.
- [Redirects and history](https://inertia-dotnet.temtem.dev/docs/redirects-and-history): Redirects, Back, Location, history encryption, clearing and URL fragments.
- [Error pages](https://inertia-dotnet.temtem.dev/docs/error-pages): Render routing failures and unhandled exceptions as Inertia pages, with shared props and the original status.

## Loading data

- [Partial reloads](https://inertia-dotnet.temtem.dev/docs/partial-reloads): Reload only the props a page needs with only and except filters.
- [Deferred props](https://inertia-dotnet.temtem.dev/docs/deferred-props): Load slow page sections after the first render, in groups.
- [Merging props](https://inertia-dotnet.temtem.dev/docs/merging-props): Append, prepend, deep merge and match items instead of replacing the client's value.
- [Once props](https://inertia-dotnet.temtem.dev/docs/once-props): Remember expensive values on the client and skip them on later visits.
- [Infinite scroll](https://inertia-dotnet.temtem.dev/docs/infinite-scroll): Merge pages of items and report paging metadata to the InfiniteScroll client component.
- [Pagination](https://inertia-dotnet.temtem.dev/docs/pagination): Create numbered and cursor pages for pagers and infinite scroll.
- [Live props](https://inertia-dotnet.temtem.dev/docs/live-props): Props that refresh themselves when the server broadcasts an event.
- [Precognition](https://inertia-dotnet.temtem.dev/docs/precognition): Validate a form before submission without running its handler.

## Production

- [Server-side rendering](https://inertia-dotnet.temtem.dev/docs/server-side-rendering): Render the first visit on Bun or Node, supervise the process from .NET, and fall back safely.
- [Vite](https://inertia-dotnet.temtem.dev/docs/vite-integration): Manifest tags, the dev-server hot file, asset base URLs, prefetching and CSP nonces.
- [Asset versioning](https://inertia-dotnet.temtem.dev/docs/asset-versioning): Tell the client when its JavaScript and CSS are stale, and reload once when they are.
- [CSRF protection](https://inertia-dotnet.temtem.dev/docs/csrf-and-antiforgery): Protect forms with the XSRF-TOKEN cookie and the X-XSRF-TOKEN header.
- [Deploying behind a proxy](https://inertia-dotnet.temtem.dev/docs/deploying): Forwarded headers, secure cookies, compression, asset caching and multi-instance state.
- [Native AOT](https://inertia-dotnet.temtem.dev/docs/native-aot): Publish a Native AOT Inertia.Net app with source-generated JSON metadata.
- [Performance](https://inertia-dotnet.temtem.dev/docs/performance): Memory and hosting guidance, payload limits and the design choices behind the adapter.
- [Multiple apps and libraries](https://inertia-dotnet.temtem.dev/docs/mounts): Mount a second Inertia UI under its own path, with its own shared props, asset version, state cookie, root view, error pages and SSR.

## Reference

- [Configuration](https://inertia-dotnet.temtem.dev/docs/configuration): InertiaOptions, Vite, SSR, props, state and the middleware and result API.
- [TypeScript types](https://inertia-dotnet.temtem.dev/docs/typescript): Generate declarations for page props, shared props and flash data from your .NET contracts.
- [Testing](https://inertia-dotnet.temtem.dev/docs/testing): Fluent assertions over Inertia responses and helpers for partial reloads and deferred props.
- [DevTools](https://inertia-dotnet.temtem.dev/docs/devtools): Record visits for the Inertia DevTools extension and catch missing page components during development.
- [Troubleshooting](https://inertia-dotnet.temtem.dev/docs/troubleshooting): Common errors, their causes, and how to fix them.

## Tutorial

- [Build a todo app](https://inertia-dotnet.temtem.dev/docs/forget-me-not): Build a complete Inertia.Net todo app with session login, public lists, paginated loading, reminders and SSR.
